html:
This full day snorkeling tour is designed for travelers who want to explore the most beautiful coral reefs in southern Phu Quoc. Visiting three stunning islands, the tour offers excellent snorkeling opportunities, crystal clear waters, and relaxed beach time. Guests will enjoy snorkeling at two different coral reef sites, lunch served on board, and free time at the lively May Rut Trong Island, making it a perfect combination of adventure and leisure.

Highlights

  • Full day boat trip to three popular islands in southern Phu Quoc

  • Snorkeling at Xuong (Buom) Island and Gam Ghi Island coral reefs

  • Explore one of the largest coral reef areas around Phu Quoc

  • Lunch served on board

  • Free time at May Rut Trong Island for swimming and beach activities

Itinerary

08:15 – 08:30

Pick up at hotels in Duong Dong Ward (for hotels outside this area, please contact us in advance).

Transfer to An Thoi Harbor.

Board the boat and begin the journey to the southern islands of Phu Quoc.

Xuong Island (or Buom Island)

First snorkeling stop. Swim in clear waters and explore the colorful underwater world.

Gam Ghi Island

Second snorkeling stop. This area is home to one of the largest and most diverse coral reefs around Phu Quoc Island.

Lunch on Board

Enjoy a freshly prepared lunch while relaxing on the boat.

May Rut Trong Island

Free time to relax, swim, sunbathe, enjoy the white sand beach, visit the beach bar, take photos, or participate in water activities (at own expense).

17:00

Return to An Thoi Harbor and transfer back to your hotel.

Tour Price

  • Adult: USD 22 / pax (from 10 years old)

  • Children (5–9 years): USD 12 / pax

  • Children under 5 years: Free of charge

Tour Includes

  • Round trip transportation by car and boat

  • English speaking tour guide

  • Lunch

  • 1 bottle of water per person

  • Snorkeling equipment (mask, snorkel, fins subject to size availability)

  • Life jackets

Tour Excludes

  • Personal expenses

  • Fresh water shower, sunbed rental, and other service fees on the island

Lunch Menu

  • Steamed shrimp

  • Sweet and sour sautéed squid

  • Braised fish in clay pot

  • Vegetable soup with minced pork

  • Deep fried tofu with lemongrass

  • Stir fried morning glory with garlic

  • Omelette

  • Steamed rice

  • Fresh fruit

Vegetarian, vegan, and children’s meals are available upon request at least 24 hours before departure.

Important Notes

  • The itinerary may be adjusted depending on weather and sea conditions.

  • Please bring towels, swimwear, spare clothes, suitable footwear, eco-friendly sunscreen, and some cash.

Children’s Pricing Policy

  • Children aged 10 and above: adult price

  • Children aged 5–9: 50% of adult price

  • Children under 5: free of charge

Payment Policy

Groups of 1–5 guests:

  • 50% deposit upon booking

  • Balance to be paid no later than 1 day before or on the tour day

Groups of 6 guests or more:

  • 50% deposit upon booking

  • Balance to be paid no later than 1 day before the tour date

Cancellation Policy

Groups of 1–5 guests:

  • Cancellation 1 day before tour date: free of charge

  • Cancellation on tour date: 100% charge

Groups of 6 guests or more:

  • Cancellation 2 days before tour date: free of charge

  • Cancellation 1 day before tour date: 50% charge

  • Cancellation on tour date: 100% charge

Weather related cancellations:

  • If the Port Authority does not allow departure, Vietlook Travel will cancel and provide a full refund.

  • If the tour is permitted to operate and guests choose to cancel, no refund will be provided.

Health And Safety

  • Not recommended for guests with limited mobility or serious medical conditions.

  • Pregnant women and elderly guests should consult their doctors before joining.

  • Guests must follow the tour guide’s safety instructions at all times.
